riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine attention to detail + steady hands + approachability. Adjustments must be effective and accurate, while technical work, trust, and clear explanations stay balanced.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops judgment through the hands. Chiropractors need enough anatomy knowledge to identify misalignment and steady technique to apply the right force. It suits careful, approachable people who accept responsibility for rehabilitation and enjoy seeing pain ease.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping people, investigation, and practical work (Social S + Investigative I + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 手稳 + 有亲和」凑一块的人——人要调得也要调对，技术和信任要平衡也要会讲。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手上的判断」——既要懂解剖看得准错位，也要有把力道用对的稳手。适合细致、有亲和力、也愿意对康复负责的人，也享受从疼痛到缓解的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、钻研、也务实（社会 S + 钻研 I + 务实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy getting things done for others. A thoughtful room setup, a perfect recommendation, or a timely greeting produces the guest's smile, the most direct reward in the job.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this work is making the impossible possible. A guest casually asks for a restaurant that locals visit. Within half an hour, you secure a table and know the signature dishes. The guest's surprise provides immediate, motivating recognition.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「帮人办成事」当乐趣的人——一个惊喜布置、一次完美推荐、一句及时的问候，客人的笑容就是这份工作最直接的工资。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的乐趣在于「把不可能变可能」：客人随口说一句「明天想去一家本地人常去的馆子」，你半小时内订到位子还把招牌菜摸清了；看着客人惊喜的表情，这种即时被认可的成就感很上瘾。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Electrical And Electronics Repairers, Powerhouse, Substation, And Relay

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy protecting grid safety. Every protection device they calibrate helps keep power available to thousands of households.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this career lies in grid safety. Every protection device you verify helps safeguard electricity for thousands of households. People who enjoy electrical principles, work well with instruments, and respect procedures can find stable technical satisfaction here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 电厂、变电站与继电器电气维修工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「把电网安全兜住」的人——你校准的每一套保护，都在为千家万户的灯兜底。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「电网安全」——你校验过的每一套保护，都在为千家万户的用电兜底。喜欢钻研电气原理、动手能力强、敬畏规章的人，会在这里找到安稳的技术成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 研究型 I + 事务型 C

breadcrumb.label: Farm Equipment Mechanics And Service Technicians

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The role fits people who combine an interest in machinery, hands-on ability, and physical stamina. Repairing a machine independently provides a grounded sense of accomplishment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work combines hands-on repair with technical problem solving. Mechanics work through oil and dirt while interpreting circuits and hydraulic diagrams. The role suits people who enjoy machines, dislike sitting in an office, and feel compelled to repair broken equipment so field work can continue.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and orderly processes (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 农场设备机械师技术员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱机械 + 动手 + 能扛活」凑一块的人——机器坏了自己修好，比啥都踏实。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「动手里的解题」——既要在油污里拆得动，也要读得懂电路和液压图。适合爱机械、坐不住办公室、看见机器坏就手痒去修的人，也享受「修好一台、地里的活接着干」的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实干、钻研、也讲条理（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: It suits people who want to earn through a trade. Each shingle reflects growing skill as a helper advances to roofer, and income rises with capability.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This role begins the path from apprentice to craftsperson. Learn waterproofing membrane, shingle installation, and drainage systems alongside experienced roofers, then advance to independent roofing after the difficult early period.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合想「靠手艺吃饭」的人——从帮工干到师傅，每一片瓦都印着自己的手艺，收入也跟着手艺涨。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行是「从学徒到师傅」的起点：跟着老师傅在屋顶上摸爬，学防水卷材、瓦片铺设、排水系统这些手艺，熬过前期，就能往独立屋顶工走。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This profession is suitable for people who "have a mission to save people and can withstand heavy pressures" - during ward rounds, they see patients getting better day by day, and their families go from anxious to relieved. This professional value of being trusted and needed is a long-term reward beyond money.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most fulfilling thing in this profession is "bringing a serious patient back from danger" - the eyes of family members are full of anxiety when he is admitted to hospital, and the patient can walk away on his own when discharged. This kind of visible treatment result is the most direct career reward for residents.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Research type I + Social type S + Transaction type C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把救人当使命、也扛得住重压」的人——查房时看到病人一天天好转，家属从焦虑到放心，这种被信任、被需要的职业价值，是金钱之外的长期回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的是「把一个重病人从危险里拉回来」——入院时家属眼里全是焦虑，出院时病人能自己走着离开，这种看得见的治疗成果，是住院医师最直接的职业回报。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 社会型 S + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine practicality, resilience, and steady hands. Garments must be cleaned and protected, balancing process requirements with quality control.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops familiarity with hands-on work. It requires understanding fabrics and patiently removing stains, fitting practical, resilient people who take responsibility for finished items and enjoy seeing garments restored.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic and hands-on (Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 皮实 + 手稳」凑一块的人——衣要洗得净也要护得好，工艺和质检要平衡也要敢上手。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「对手里活儿的熟」——既要懂面料也要有去渍的耐心。适合务实、皮实、又愿意对成品负责的人，也享受「亮出来」的爽感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、动手（企业 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine attention to detail, calmness, and reliable execution. Screenings must run smoothly and clearly, requiring a balance of equipment operation and inspection and the confidence to intervene.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops error-free consistency. Projectionists must understand equipment and signals and carefully confirm everything before the show begins. It suits practical, quiet people who take responsibility for the audience experience and appreciate the moment the lights go down and the image appears.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, orderly work (Enterprising R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 安静 + 稳得出」凑一块的人——场要放得顺也要放得清，设备和巡检要平衡也要敢处置。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「不出错的稳」——既要懂设备与信号，也要有开场前把一切确认好的细心。适合务实、安静、又愿意对体验负责的人，也享受「灯灭画面起」的踏实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守序（企业 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most moving part of this work is knowing your art genuinely affected someone. A listener got through a difficult period with your song, or found resonance at your show. A musician's value is ultimately defined by the people they move.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The greatest value in this field is the live moment: the audience singing along, applauding, or even tearing up at your song. A musician's finest moment often exists in a single instant.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Artistic A + Enterprising E + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最动人的是「你的作品真的影响过别人」：有人听着你的歌走过了低谷，有人在你的现场找到共鸣——音乐人的价值，最终由那些被打动的人来定义。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有价值的是「现场的那一下」：演出时台下的合唱、掌声、甚至有人听着你的歌红了眼眶——音乐人的高光时刻，往往就藏在某一个瞬间里。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 艺术型 A + 企业型 E + 现实型 R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who treat protocols as a creed and images as their work. Every qualified diagnostic image reflects your insistence on detail.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The greatest value in this work is using images to help physicians find lesions. A PET image you scan can help a physician confirm a tumor stage and target a treatment plan, which is the purpose of a Nuclear Medicine Technologist.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把规程当信仰、把图像当作品」的人——每一张合格的诊断图像背后，都是你对细节的较真。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有价值的是「图像帮医生找到病灶」——那张你扫出来的 PET 图像，让医生确诊了肿瘤分期，让治疗方案有的放矢，这就是核医学技师的意义。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine gentleness + patience + hands-on ability. Training must produce results and continue over time, requiring a balance of professional technique and emotional support.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops professionalism through patience. Assistants must understand movement training and human function while providing emotional support. It suits gentle, patient people willing to watch gradual improvement and who enjoy helping patients progress from guided practice to independence.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping, practical, and investigative work (Social S + Realistic R + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「温和 + 耐心 + 动手」凑一块的人——训练要练得出也要陪得久，专业和情绪要平衡也要会接。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「耐心里的专业」——既要懂动作训练和人体功能，也要有把患者情绪接住的人情。适合温和、坐得住、又愿意看人一点点变好的人，也享受从陪练到患者独立的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、务实、也探究（社会 S + 务实 R + 探究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine rigor + attention to detail + patience. Medications must be identified accurately and dispensed reliably, requiring a balance of speed and zero errors with strong communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops attention to detail and patience. Medication names must be identified accurately, dosages verified correctly, and patient questions answered clearly. It suits rigorous people who can remain focused, are interested in pharmaceuticals, and appreciate safely placing medications into patients' hands.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, order, and research (Conventional C + Realistic R + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「严谨 + 细心 + 有耐心」凑一块的人——药要认得准也要发得稳，速度和零差错要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细心与耐心」——药名要认得准，剂量要核得对，患者要答得清。适合严谨、坐得住、对医药有兴趣的人，也享受把药安全交到患者手里的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守序、也研究（常规 C + 现实 R + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine calm + quick responses + accountability. Information must be complete and dispatch accurate, while multiple parties and response pace require balanced communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops calm coordination. Information must be complete, assignments accurate, and multiple agencies aligned. It suits composed, quick-thinking, accountable people who value the achievement of bringing crises under control.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Helpful, practical, and orderly (Social S + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「冷静 + 反应 + 担当」凑一块的人——信息要问得全也要派得准，多方和节奏要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「冷静与协调」——信息要问得全，单要派得准，多方要调得拢。适合沉稳、反应快、有担当的人，也享受把危急摁住的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、务实、也守序（社会 S + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines reading, thinking, debating, and writing. It suits people who can identify the logic of power in a dataset and are willing to argue over a single sentence for hours.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most exciting part is understanding the logic of the world: demographic change lies behind an election result, and the consequences of a policy can be traced ten years into the future. It suits people who enjoy reading, thinking, and debating and can also sit down to analyze data.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis while also valuing advocacy and expression (Investigative I + Enterprising E + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「读、想、辩、写」凑一块的人——能从一份数据里看出权力逻辑，也愿意为一句话和人吵半天。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最带劲的是「看懂世界的逻辑」——一份选举结果背后是 demographic 变迁，一项政策后果能追到十年后。适合爱读、爱想、爱辩论，又能坐下来跑数据的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究思考、也重理念表达（研究 I + 企业 E + 艺术 A）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine attention to detail, clear boundaries, and composure, protecting the security baseline while balancing rules and relationships.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Attention to detail is the most demanding aspect of this work. One missed access permission or inspection route can lead to a major incident. It suits careful, boundary-conscious people who balance rules with relationships, and sound judgment under pressure is essential.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be organized, rules-oriented, and willing to coordinate (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 边界感 + 临场稳」凑一块的人——在规矩和人情之间，把安全底线守住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人的是「细」——一个门禁权限、一条巡检路线没排到，出事就是大事。适合细心、有边界感、能在规矩和人情之间拿捏的人，临场判断也是硬指标。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好有条理、重规则、也愿做组织（企业 E + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine excellent ears, aesthetic judgment, and patience. They can spend half an hour repeatedly adjusting one reverb and distinguish warm from cool timbres.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most satisfying part of this field is hearing change. A thin vocal becomes alive after you add space and body. It suits people with excellent ears who love sound and patiently refine details in dark rooms.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They tend to be hands-on, practical, and expressive (Realistic R + Investigative I + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「耳朵 + 审美 + 耐心」凑一块的人——能为一处混响反复调半小时，也分得清冷暖音色。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最治愈的是「听见变化」——一段干瘪的人声经你手加上空间和厚度，立刻活了。适合耳朵好、爱声音、能在暗室里抠细节的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实操、重现实、也善表达（现实 R + 研究 I + 艺术 A）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine attention to detail + spatial awareness + field mobility. Coordinates must be precise and stable, and the role moves between the field and the office.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work demands millimeter-level rigor. Surveyors must understand instruments and coordinate systems while coordinating boundary disputes among contractors and owners. It suits detail-oriented people who can concentrate in the office, handle field visits, and enjoy the full process from establishing points to delivering maps.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and orderly processes (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 空间感 + 能跑现场」凑一块的人——坐标要准也要稳，现场和办公室要两头跑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「毫米级的较真」——既要懂仪器和坐标系统，也要协调施工方与业主对边界的争执。适合细致、坐得住、又能跑现场的人，也享受从布点到交图的完整过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、钻研、也讲条理（企业 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who see the person and imagine the performance. You look beyond a face to judge whether someone can step in front of the camera and make the role their own.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most compelling moment in this field is turning overlooked potential into success. A newcomer whom no one believed in can bring a role to life because you championed them, creating an incomparable sense of achievement. Behind many iconic characters is a casting director who held firm.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Artistic A + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「眼里有人、心里有戏」的人——你看人不只是看脸，而是看这个人站上镜头那一刻，能不能把角色变成自己的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最迷人的是「点石成金」的瞬间：一个没人看好的新人，因为你力排众议选进项目，最后演活了，那种成就感比什么都值。行业里很多经典角色的诞生，背后都有一个坚持的选角导演。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 艺术型 A + 社会型 S

breadcrumb.label: Transportation Vehicle, Equipment And Systems Inspectors, Except Aviation

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who enjoy stopping hazards before accidents happen. Every signature confirms their professional judgment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The sense of purpose comes from finding hazards. A problem you discover can prevent an accident. People who enjoy machinery, work methodically, and willingly visit sites can find meaning here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「把隐患拦在事故发生前」的人——每一次签字，都是对自己专业判断的确认。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的踏实感来自「发现隐患」——你查到的问题可能避免一次事故。喜欢和机械设备打交道、做事有章法、愿意走现场的人，会在这里找到价值感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I
